relationships.note: Both are him conceding a failure, but this one is an outcome rather than a date, and it has a named consequence behind it.
The other place where a miss is conceded outright rather than reframed as a delay.
He names the red wave everybody believes is coming and denies it in the same breath: barely keep the House, lose the Senate.
The exemption that makes the death toll costless to the listener: the fall is at their side and does not come near them.
The device that absorbs a timing miss: an event arriving off schedule becomes an early release rather than an error.
Purple appears in both and is never given a meaning in either.
